Ordering (section 10): Comparer<T>.Default, IComparable<T>, authored IComparer<T>, OrderBy/ThenBy, Min/Max/MinBy, List<T>.Sort with ranges and comparers, error wrapping, and tuple ordering over a nonconforming element. Probe forwards <Group><Case>: Ord, Sort, Tup. Expected values are .NET 10's (probes b6-parity and b6-extra), with OrderBy materialized by ToList() as section 10's eager queries are. NeoInvalidOperationError is InvalidOperationException and InnerError is InnerException.
source: class M : IComparable<M> { public int V = 0; public M(int v) { V = v; } public int CompareTo(M? o) { return V - o!.V; } public override bool Equals(object? obj) { return obj is M m && m.V == V; } public override int GetHashCode() { return V; } }
class N { public int V = 0; public N(int v) { V = v; } }
class Ci : EqualityComparer<string> { public override bool Equals(string? x, string? y) => x?.ToLower() == y?.ToLower(); public override int GetHashCode(string obj) => obj.ToLower().GetHashCode(); }
class Rev : IComparer<int> { public int Compare(int x, int y) { return y - x; } }
class Thrower : IComparer<int> { public int Compare(int x, int y) { throw new NeoArgumentError("boom"); } }
class Probe {
static string J(List<int> l) { string s = ""; foreach (var x in l) s += x; return s; }
public static int OrdA() { List<M> l = [new M(1), new M(1), new M(2)]; return l.ToSet().Count; }
public static int OrdB() { List<M> l = [new M(1), new M(1), new M(2)]; return l.Distinct().Count; }
public static int OrdC() { List<string> l = ["a", "A", "b"]; return l.Distinct(new Ci()).Count; }
public static bool OrdD() { List<string> l = ["a", "A", "b"]; Set<string> s = l.ToSet(new Ci()); return s.Contains("B"); }
public static int OrdF() { List<M> l = [new M(3), new M(1), new M(2)]; return l.OrderBy(m => m).First().V; }
public static int OrdG() { List<int> l = [1, 3, 2]; return l.OrderBy(x => x, new Rev()).First(); }
public static int OrdH() { List<int> l = [1, 3, 2]; return l.Min(new Rev()); }
public static int OrdI() { List<M> l = [new M(3), new M(1), new M(2)]; return l.Max()!.V; }
public static int OrdJ() { List<M> l = [new M(3), new M(1), new M(2)]; return l.MinBy(m => m.V, new Rev())!.V; }

public static string OrdK() { List<int> l = [1, 3, 2]; try { l.OrderBy(x => x, new Thrower()).First(); return "no"; } catch (NeoInvalidOperationError e) { return e.Message + "|" + e.InnerError!.Message; } }
public static string OrdL() { List<int> l = [1, 3, 2]; try { l.Min(new Thrower()); return "no"; } catch (NeoArgumentError e) { return e.Message; } }
public static string OrdN() { List<string> l = ["a", "A", "b"]; var g = l.GroupBy(x => x, new Ci()); return g.Count + ":" + g["a"].Count; }
public static int OrdO() { List<M> l = [new M(2), new M(1), new M(3)]; return l.OrderBy(m => m.V % 2).ThenByDescending(m => m).Last().V; }
public static int OrdP() { List<M> l = [new M(2), new M(1), new M(3)]; return l.OrderByDescending(m => m, Comparer<M>.Default).First().V; }
public static string SortA() { List<int> l = [3, 1, 2]; l.Sort(new Rev()); return J(l); }
public static string SortB() { List<int> l = [5, 4, 3, 2, 1]; l.Sort(1, 3, null); return J(l); }
public static string SortC() { List<int> l = [5, 4, 3, 2, 1]; l.Sort(0, 2, new Rev()); l.Sort(2, 3, Comparer<int>.Default); return J(l); }
public static int SortD() { List<M> l = [new M(3), new M(1), new M(2)]; l.Sort(); return l[0].V; }
public static string SortE() { List<N> l = [new N(3), new N(1)]; try { l.Sort(); return "no"; } catch (NeoInvalidOperationError e) { return e.Message + "|" + e.InnerError!.Message; } }
public static string SortF() { List<int> l = [3, 1, 2]; try { l.Sort(new Thrower()); return "no"; } catch (NeoInvalidOperationError e) { return e.Message + "|" + e.InnerError!.Message; } }
public static string SortG() { List<int> l = [3, 1, 2]; try { l.Sort(-1, 2, null); return "no"; } catch (NeoArgumentOutOfRangeError e) { return e.Message; } }
public static string SortH() { List<int> l = [3, 1, 2]; try { l.Sort(1, 5, null); return "no"; } catch (NeoArgumentError e) { return e.Message; } }
public static string SortI() { List<int> l = [3, 1, 2]; l.Sort((a, b) => b - a); return J(l); }

public static string TupG() { List<(N, int)> l = [(new N(1), 1), (new N(2), 0)]; try { l.Sort(); return "no"; } catch (NeoInvalidOperationError e) { return e.Message + "|" + e.InnerError!.Message; } }

public static string TupH() { List<(N, int)> l = [(new N(1), 1), (new N(2), 0)]; try { l.OrderBy(x => x).First(); return "no"; } catch (NeoInvalidOperationError e) { return e.Message + "|" + e.InnerError!.Message; } }
public static bool TupN2() { return Comparer<(int, string)>.Default.Compare((1, "b"), (1, "a")) > 0; }
